basis: Predeclared engineering targets, not a measured 100000-image baseline. RSS adopts the existing 464 MiB capacity target. GC requires conservative per-pause histogram upper bounds of at most 50 ms and both completed-cycle counter and histogram upper-sum ratios of at most 1%. The single workload uses distinct local sources from three repeated templates, two HTTP clients, default image and password budgets, and no forced collection or cooldown. The 1-hour bound limits test resources and is not a speed SLA.
